root.label: U.S. launches campaign of air strikes against suspected drug-trafficking vessels

events.label: U.S. launches campaign of air strikes against suspected drug-trafficking vessels

slots.name: strike deaths
slots.sentence: A year ago, the US government launched a campaign of air strikes against vessels suspected of being used for drug trafficking in the Caribbean and the eastern Pacific, which left more than 200 dead – without providing evidence and raising human rights concerns.

slots.name: drug seizure increase
slots.sentence: The Coast Guard, which oversees most drug seizures on water, recorded a 200% increase in seizures in fiscal year 2025 compared with other annual averages.
